definitions.explanation: A large, mild-flavored white radish commonly used in Japanese cooking.

examples.japanese: {大根|だいこん}おろしを{作|つく}る。
おでんには{大根|だいこん}が{欠|か}かせない。
{大根|だいこん}を{煮|に}て{味|あじ}を{染|し}み{込|こ}ませる。
examples.english: To simmer daikon until the flavor soaks in.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}に{大根|だいこん}おろしを{添|そ}える。
examples.english: To serve grilled fish with grated daikon.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}の{大根|だいこん}は{甘|あま}くて、{煮物|にもの}にすると{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Winter daikon is sweet and delicious when made into simmered dishes.

notes:
{大根|だいこん} is one of the most important vegetables in Japanese cuisine.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- {大根|だいこん}おろし: grated daikon (served with grilled fish)
- おでんの{大根|だいこん}: simmered daikon in oden
- {切|き}り{干|ぼ}し{大根|だいこん}: dried shredded daikon
- たくあん: pickled daikon

EXPRESSION: {大根役者|だいこんやくしゃ} means 'bad actor' (daikon doesn't cause food poisoning, like a bad actor who 'doesn't hit').
